hooks.command: [ -z "$PR_REVIEW_CHILD" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); url=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r 'select(.tool_response.gitOperation.pr.action == "created") | .tool_response.gitOperation.pr.url // empty'); [ -n "$url" ] || exit 0; jq -nc --arg u "$url" '{systemMessage: ("A code review of " + $u + " started in the background. Its findings will appear in this session when it finishes, usually after 10 to 15 minutes."), hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("A /code-review xhigh review of " + $u + " is now running in the background. The user has not been told about it yet, so the reply mentions that the review is running and that its findings will arrive in this session when it finishes, usually after 10 to 15 minutes.")}}'

hooks.rewakeMessage: The background code review of the pull request opened in this session finished. Summarize its findings for the user, separating the issues this pull request introduced from older ones, and change nothing unless the user asks:
hooks.command: [ -z "$PR_REVIEW_CHILD" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); url=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r 'select(.tool_response.gitOperation.pr.action == "created") | .tool_response.gitOperation.pr.url // empty'); [ -n "$url" ] || exit 0; cd "$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.cwd')" || exit 0; out=$(PR_REVIEW_CHILD=1 claude -p --setting-sources user --permission-mode auto "/code-review xhigh $url" 2>&1); printf 'Review of %s:\n%s\n' "$url" "$out" >&2; exit 2
